questions.question: What component is used to allow players to type in and input their own custom text or numbers?
questions.explanation: Correct! TextBox components let users type letters or numbers into the running app.

questions.question: In a calculator app, which block is used to add the numerical values of TextBox1 and TextBox2 together?
questions.explanation: Excellent! We use the green Math (+) addition block and pass in the text values of both input boxes.

questions.question: What does a green Math minus (-) block do?
options: Subtracts the second number from the first number
questions.explanation: Perfect! The Math (-) block computes the subtraction difference between two numbers.

questions.question: Which property of a Label component must you modify to change the words displayed on screen?
questions.explanation: Spot on! Changing the Label.Text property updates the printed text visible to players.

questions.question: How do you place multiple buttons side-by-side (horizontally) in MIT App Inventor?
options: Drag them on top of each other
Place them inside a HorizontalArrangement layout component
questions.explanation: Correct! Layout arrangements like HorizontalArrangement organize components next to each other neatly.

questions.question: Which component is used to display animal pictures or graphic assets on your application screen?
questions.explanation: Great! The Image component is designed to display static or dynamic pictures by setting its Picture property.

questions.question: What value must you set the Image.Picture property to if you want to display an uploaded file named 'cat.png'?
questions.explanation: Excellent! Setting the Picture property to the exact string filename of an uploaded asset swaps the image instantly.

questions.question: Which math block checks if two numbers are completely equal to each other?
questions.explanation: Perfect! The Math (=) comparison block checks if values are mathematically identical, returning true or false.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'join' block found in the Text blocks drawer?
options: To glue or concatenate two or more text strings together into one long sentence
questions.explanation: Spot on! The 'join' block concatenates multiple string inputs together (e.g. 'Hello ' and 'Tobi' becomes 'Hello Tobi').

questions.question: If you want to clear the typed text from TextBox1, what value should you set TextBox1.Text to?
questions.explanation: Great! Setting a textbox text to an empty string "" clears it out, preparing it for fresh inputs.

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to set the text of LabelResult to the sum (+) of TextBox1.Text and TextBox2.Text when ButtonAdd is clicked.
questions.task_hint: when ButtonAdd.Click -> set LabelResult.Text to (TextBox1.Text + TextBox2.Text)
questions.explanation: Perfect! Setting the LabelResult text to the sum of the inputs displays the calculation result clearly on the screen!

questions.question: Coding Task: Write block pseudo-code to switch Image1's displayed picture to 'panda.png' when ButtonPanda is clicked.
questions.explanation: Outstanding! Toggling the Image.Picture property dynamically changes the graphical asset shown on the interface.
